I am a research assistant at the **[Fraunhofer Heinrich Hertz Institute](https://www.hhi.fraunhofer.de/)** in Berlin, supervised by Moritz Weckbecker and part of the Explainable AI group led by Dr. Sebastian Lapuschkin, within the Artificial Intelligence department headed by Prof. Dr. Wojciech Samek. I am a Master's student in Computer Science at the Hasso Plattner Institute in Potsdam.

## Research Interests

I currently work on backdoor detection methods for LoRA adapters using weight-space learning. In particular, I focus on better understanding the backdoor mechanism implanted by fine-tuning, by applying feature attribution methods to the meta-classifier model.

More broadly, I am interested in AI safety and interpretability, and I want to better understand fine-tuning phenomena such as emergent misalignment and unexpected generalization.
